title: Terra Clean Tenders Transmission Infrastructure for Renewable Projects
summary: Terra Clean (TeCL), a wholly owned subsidiary of the Indian Oil Corporation, has invited bids for the empanelment of engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) contractors for design, engineering, supply, construction, testing, and commissioning of pooling substation, extra high voltage (EHV) transmission line, associated power evacuation system, and related works for interstate transmission system (ISTS) and intrastate transmission system (InSTS)-connected renewable projects (solar/wind/wind-solar hybrid projects with or without battery storage).

direction_reasons: No clear directional signal in the available text
WAAREEENER.why_it_matters: This reaches the company indirectly via its customer exposure to EPC contractors. The parts of the business most likely touched are revenue, customers. Classified as tender.
